Used Reddit a lot, lurked a ton. I liked to give upvotes, but quickly found out that you can't really do that unless you comment and whatnot on here, so here I am. Kinda tired so I'm just going to sorta throw out what I think about Voat at the moment...

I was sort of hesitant about using Voat due to there not being an Android app at the time (used BaconReader for Reddit), but I quickly found that the web version on FF was pretty good, and then Boats came and boom. Aside from the lagginess, Voat is pretty great, but one thing I'm concerned about it is it's expansion. Reddit, the way I see it, got super huge and was able to by partnering with Imgur and having a lot of stress on their end and not theirs. Are Voaters going to use Imgur still, or is there some other variant of it? And as for expansion, I've read a bit that the owner of the site is some Swiss dude in college? Like I said, I love the idea of a transparent, open (competitor/replacement?) of Reddit, but one thing I saw that was good about Reddit was that it was up most of the time, and when you got a heavy load error, you could refresh within like, 5 seconds and you'd be good to go.

Umm.. let's see here... Aside from people who've migrated, I'm also thinking about new users. Why would somebody that doesn't know anything about the recent events choose Voat over Reddit? In their mind, they might think: "Meh, Voat seems okay but it's slow, and there's much more on Reddit." Do you guys think this is a little early to pontificate on that issue, maybe allow Voat to become more stable and then think about that issue?

As for the subreddits I was subscribed to... most of them are here! A lot of the front page subs are here and most have over 1k users, so that's cool. There were a few that weren't though, but those were very specific and kinda niche. I'll give it time. (r/autechre, for example)

Karma. Do we call it that on Voat, or is it something else?

Other than that... yeah. I'm here. I took a bike ride on my new Trek 1.2 I got yesterday. It was nice. Minnesota weather can be nice actually.

Yeah, cool! Glad to be here. Probably won't visit Reddit much longer.
